description: Claude Code plugin (v0.1.1-preview, source-available, FSL-1.1-ALv2) that keeps the working tree of one git branch in sync between teammates' clones through the project's own git remote. No server.
rules: cowork-sync is a preview: use it on a test repository only.
Install in a Claude Code session: /plugin marketplace add Kingyoungmins/cowork-sync, then /plugin install cowork-sync@cowork-sync, then /reload-plugins.
Commands are typed in full as /cowork-sync:cowork <verb>; verbs in this preview: start, status, stop, view, help. The bare /cowork does not resolve.
It needs a private git remote that accepts custom refs (refs/cowork/*) and enforces --force-with-lease.
In this preview Claude sessions do not know about the sync (no hooks, no MCP tools), and there is no save step that turns shared work into a commit.
The licence is source-available (FSL-1.1-ALv2), not open source.
